title: ByteDance is preparing a real-time spatial video model under Zhang Yiming, Bloomberg reports
description: ByteDance is readying a Seedance-based spatial video model for Pico headsets, rendered in the cloud at roughly 50 milliseconds of latency.

title: Reducing Zod's memory footprint by an order of magnitude with method memoization
description: A bare z.string() retained 7.5kb of heap in Zod 4.4. In Zod 4.5 it retains 784 bytes. One change to where a schema's methods live accounts for nearly all of it.

title: China’s answer to ASML runs on Zeiss lenses, Financial Times reports
description: Huawei is funding China's lithography suppliers and pushing their tools into SMIC. The flagship machine uses Zeiss lenses sold only to ASML.

title: Review a pull request by booting it | Farid Zakaria’s Blog
description: tl;dr; trynix-preview is a GitHub action that comments a link on a pull request which lets you boot the PR’s build in the browser using https://trynix.dev. No servers, just browser
